name: NVIDIA TITAN V

flops.basis_detail: Product page states more than 110 TeraFLOPS of deep-learning performance from 640 Tensor Cores, and the launch press release says 110 teraflops. Neither names the precision, so this is filed as other rather than guessed as fp16. It is a tensor-core peak, not a CUDA-core FP32 figure.

notes: First-party spec table: Volta, 12 GB HBM2, 1455 MHz boost clock, 640 Tensor Cores, 5120 CUDA cores, 21.1 billion transistors, TSMC 12 nm FFN, launched December 2017 at $2,999. Bandwidth and board power are null because neither the product page nor the launch press release prints them, and an aggregator figure is not substituted. 12 GB of HBM2 holds a 7B Q4 with modest KV headroom and does not hold a 13B Q4. No NVLink is stated on the product page, so the host PCIe link is the only interconnect recorded. || Filled 2026-10-19: Volta GV100-based: 12 GB HBM2 on a 3,072-bit interface, 652.8 GB/s. Live NVIDIA page now redirects to RTX marketing; archived vendor page/press release confirm 12 GB HBM2.
